title: Definitely worth it!
text: Probably one of the most fun experiences I have had in a while. The person that takes the crew, Martin, is super friendly and helps everyone really connect!!! Thank you Martin! Wishing you the best

title: Highly recommended

title: Barcelona with Martin
text: Martin was a great host. He showed the best places in Barcelona to meet people, having drinks and party all nigth. I totally recommend it.

title: Perfect.
text: All great.  And on time.  You guide them very kindly.. Excellent route of bars and clubs in Barcelona. Well organized
author: pauloz325

title: I think it's the best bar crawl in Barcelona!
text: We went to my bachelor friends because my friend was getting married. We loved the bars and the guides were very attentive to us. We have enjoyed it from the first moment. The bar crawl people were very funny and sociable. At every bar we have a free drink and then we enter without lining up for a spectacular nightclub! We've made friends for life. We loved this experience! I recommend it for bachelor or bachelorette parties like us!
author: 988mart_nd

title: Fantastic pubcrawl
text: Pubcrawl organized well, many people and nice places. First bar downtown and then we moved to the Barceloneta area.
